title: Shell side-nav refresh

questions.text: Rainbet puts a 2-way Casino | Sports switch at the top of the sidebar and has no product tabs in the header. Our header has 4 tabs plus an Other menu (HEADER_NAV: Casino · Sports · Poker · Promotions; OTHER_NAV: Live Betting, Racebook, Contests, Esports in shell-nav.ts), and the sidebar contents change per product (navForProduct). Should the switch move into the sidebar and the header tabs go?
questions.why: This decides the IA. With A, the header becomes logo, search, VIP/rewards and balance only, and the sidebar becomes one tree on every route. With C, we just reskin today's product-scoped sidebar body and the header stays as it is.
options: (recommended) A — Casino | Sports switch at the top of the sidebar. Header product tabs and Other are removed. Poker, Promotions, Racebook, Esports and Contests become sidebar groups/rows. Header keeps logo, search, VIP and Login/Join or balance.
B — Put the switch in the sidebar but keep the header tabs too. Lower risk, but product nav appears twice.
C — Keep the header tabs as they are and only rebuild the sidebar body: reward widget, quick links, collapsible groups, utilities.
questions.answer: B — Put the switch in the sidebar but keep the header tabs too. Lower risk, but product nav appears twice.

questions.text: Rainbet's sidebar opens with a Weekly Raffle plus Daily, Weekly and Monthly race pots. BetOnline has no raffle. Daily Races only exists on the prototype lane and must stay off demo :3000 until you say Merge (PROTOTYPE_LANE.md; data in lib/lumen/daily-races). What should the sidebar widget show?
questions.why: With A, the widget can only appear on :3001 until Races merges, so demo stays without it. With B, it ships to demo right away using parts we already have. With C, there's no rewards chrome, which drops feature #19 from the scope.
options: (recommended) A — Race pots: Daily, Weekly and Monthly amounts with live countdowns, reusing daily-races data. It's hidden on demo until Races merges.
B — VIP progress card (vip-tier-progress-card.tsx) plus a Claim row that opens the VIP Hub. Can ship to demo now.
questions.answer: (recommended) A — Race pots: Daily, Weekly and Monthly amounts with live countdowns, reusing daily-races data. It's hidden on demo until Races merges.

proposalSummary: v2 with round-1 changes. (1) Header has no product links at any breakpoint, like the reference. The Casino/Sports/Poker/Promotions tabs, Other menu and tablet tabs are gone. The header is now ☰ + wordmark, then search · VIP · Login/Join or balance. The Casino | Sports switch moves into the sidebar's 68px top slot, level with the header. Live Betting, Racebook and Esports go to the Sports group; Contests goes to Promotions. (2) Originals is back as its own group: rows launch Plinko, Mines, Crash with their real thumbnails, and All Originals goes to /casino/category/originals (casino-subnav.tsx:32, lobby shelf). (3) New Releases quick link restored → /casino/category/new, which already exists. Open: Q1 only the $25K Daily Race exists (recommend a single Daily Race row); Q2 should the mobile chip row (CHIP_NAV) go too? I recommend keeping it on mobile so casino stays one tap away. Recorded: SHELL_HEADER_WIDE.md (no product links in header), SURFACES.md (check live site before dropping a peer item; Originals and New exist), feedback.md round 1.

learnings.rule: No product links in the header bar (no Casino/Sports/Poker/Promotions tabs, no Other menu) at any breakpoint. Header = menu + logo, then search · VIP · Login/Join or balance. Product switching lives in the sidebar/drawer Casino | Sports switch.

Before dropping a peer nav item as "we don't have it", check casino-subnav.tsx, the lobby shelves and casino-lobby-catalog. Don't infer from BRIEF phasing. BetOnline ships Originals (/casino/category/originals) and New (/casino/category/new).

Never call submit_prototype without capture_site screenshots of /prototype/<slug> at desktop and mobile that you've read and fixed against. If the :3001 lane is down and the studio can't start it, stop and ask for Start Prototype Lane.command to be run. Don't ship an unverified prototype to the chat.
